summary: The @gyomu/ai package serves as the core AI integration layer, providing abstractions for model management, request routing, and tool execution. It leverages Effect-based dependency injection and integrates with standard AI providers to facilitate robust, resilient text generation, structured object mapping, and embeddings.
responsibilities: Manage AI model registries and dependency injection layers for language and embedding models.
Orchestrate AI request routing and failover strategies using structured route nodes.
Define tool execution standards, context models, and integration policies.
Provide domain-specific error handling and structured diagnostics for AI operations.

capabilities.name: AI Model Registry
capabilities.description: Centralized definitions, lookup services, and Effect layers for managing available language and embedding models.

capabilities.name: Model Request Routing
capabilities.description: Configurable routing hierarchies that map request identifiers to execution nodes and support automated fallback behaviors.

capabilities.name: Tool Execution and Governance
capabilities.description: Standardized abstractions for defining AI-integrated tools, tracking active execution tasks, and evaluating approval policies.

capabilities.name: AI Service Integration
capabilities.description: Provider-agnostic parameter definitions and Vercel AI SDK integrations supporting text generation, streaming, object generation, and embeddings.

capabilities.name: Error Diagnostics
capabilities.description: Structured domain errors and contextual metadata capturing lifecycle phases and retry states for operational failure handling.

designDecisions: Utilizes Effect services and layers for dependency injection to manage model registries and routing configurations cleanly.
Implements a multi-node routing architecture to ensure resilient request execution through automated fallback mechanisms.
Enforces strict typing on tool definitions, execution contexts, and approval policies to safely bridge AI interactions with application logic.
usageGuidance: Inject the appropriate model registry layer (such as the Google model layer or Vercel AI layer) into your Effect runtime context to enable AI capabilities.
Define custom tools by implementing the tool structure and associating them with required configuration schemas and approval policies.
Use model route identifiers to direct AI operations through configured fallback paths for enhanced fault tolerance.
